ghost.name: Barnaby
ghost.who: A clockmaker who lived in this house a hundred years ago.
ghost.personality: Grumpy on the outside, very polite on the inside. Pretends to be scary, but blushes when someone is kind to him.

rooms.name: Hall
rooms.look: A dusty entrance hall. A grandfather clock ticks backwards and the stairs creak by themselves.

rooms.name: Attic
rooms.look: A low attic under the roof, full of trunks, cobwebs and moonlight.

rooms.name: Bedroom
rooms.look: A bedroom with a huge bed, dusty curtains and a wardrobe that sighs.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.look: Shelves up to the ceiling. Some books whisper when you walk past.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.look: A big old kitchen that smells of pumpkin soup, with jam jars everywhere.

rooms.name: Cellar
rooms.look: A cold cellar under the kitchen, with rows of old jam jars and a workbench.

items.name: rusty key
items.about: An old key with a pumpkin-shaped handle.

items.name: silver pocket watch
items.about: It stopped at midnight. Engraved on the back: B.

items.name: candle that never goes out
items.about: Its flame turns blue when a ghost is near.

items.name: bat whistle
items.about: When you blow it, bats start dancing.

items.name: courage cookie
items.about: One bite and you feel as brave as a lion.

clues.name: old photograph
clues.reveals: A man with a big moustache holds a silver pocket watch in front of this house. On the back: Barnaby, clockmaker, 1924.

clues.name: torn diary page
clues.reveals: "I hid my watch where the jam jars sleep, so nobody could steal it. Now I can't remember where!"

clues.name: music box
clues.reveals: It ticks like a clock. Inside, a note: Barnaby cannot rest until his watch ticks again.

clues.name: scratched inscription
clues.reveals: Scratched into the workbench: "Every night at midnight I look for it. B."

creatures.name: Sir Squeaks, a very suspicious rat
creatures.personality: Suspicious of everyone. Knows every secret of the house but only talks in exchange for something.

creatures.name: Penny, a spider afraid of the dark
creatures.personality: Shy and kind. Afraid of the dark, she would love a light.

creatures.name: the Soup Monster
creatures.personality: A big monster made of pumpkin soup. Looks scary, but only wants someone to taste his soup and say it is delicious.
